data.name: Ratan
data.gender_notes: Ratan is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit ratna, 'jewel, gem'. Its root is Sanskrit ratna (रत्न). A classical Sanskrit term for a jewel. Ratan is a Sanskrit name meaning “Jewel; gem”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ratan expresses “Jewel; gem”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ratan total 18, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

vedic_reference.note: Ratan is a common name in Hindu mythology and is associated with various gods and goddesses. It is also used as a synonym for 'gems' or 'precious stones' in Vedic texts.

historical_references.reference: A classical Sanskrit term for a jewel.
